phoneticConvention: Approximate English respelling for English-speaking readers (CAPITALS = stressed syllable; vowels ah / eh / ee / oh / oo; j and g before e/i → kh as in Scottish 'loch'; ñ → ny; ll → y; c before e/i and z → s; r is rolled; monosyllables in capitals). Standard Castilian with seseo and yeísmo. No substitute for the audio.
reviewStatus: Written by rule from validated content; native English review recommended.
title: Nuancing and solving
goal: Rephrase, nuance and solve an unexpected problem.

model.note: 'Quizás' + indicative is the simplest; 'quizá' is a variant.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Perdone, mi vuelo a París está cancelado. ¿Qué podemos hacer?
turns.phon: pehr-DOH-neh, MEE VOOEH-loh AH pah-REES ehs-TAH kahn-seh-LAH-doh. KEH poh-DEH-mohs ah-SEHR
turns.native: Excuse me, my flight to Paris is cancelled. What can we do?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Lo siento. Puede que haya otro vuelo esta noche.
turns.phon: LOH SEEEHN-toh. POOEH-deh KEH AH-yah OH-troh VOOEH-loh EHS-tah NOH-cheh
turns.native: I'm sorry. There might be another flight tonight.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: ¿Y si no hay?
turns.phon: EE SEE NOH AHEE
turns.native: And if there isn't?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: En ese caso, le ponemos en el vuelo de mañana y le pagamos el hotel.
turns.phon: EHN EH-seh KAH-soh, LEH poh-NEH-mohs EHN EHL VOOEH-loh DEH mah-NYAH-nah EE LEH pah-GAH-mohs EHL oh-TEHL

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Si he entendido bien, tengo que esperar aquí, ¿no?
turns.phon: SEE EH ehn-tehn-DEE-doh BEEEHN, TEHN-goh KEH ehs-peh-RAHR ah-KEE, NOH
turns.native: If I've understood correctly, I have to wait here, right?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Más bien no. Puede ir al hotel y le avisamos por teléfono.
turns.phon: MAHS BEEEHN NOH. POOEH-deh EER AHL oh-TEHL EE LEH ah-vee-SAH-mohs POHR teh-LEH-foh-noh

turns.phon: VAH-leh. LOH KEH KEEEH-roh deh-SEER EHS KEH neh-seh-SEE-toh yeh-GAHR AHN-tehs DEHL LOO-nehs

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Lo entiendo. Quizás hay una plaza esta noche; vuelva en una hora.
turns.phon: LOH ehn-TEEEHN-doh. kee-SAHS AHEE OO-nah PLAH-sah EHS-tah NOH-cheh, VOOEHL-vah EHN OO-nah OH-rah

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: De acuerdo, gracias.
turns.phon: DEH ah-KOOEHR-doh, GRAH-seeahs

dialogues.practice: Listen to both roles, hide one role, answer, then swap one line for a variant of your own.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Buenos días. ¿Qué le pasa?
turns.phon: BOOEH-nohs DEE-ahs. KEH LEH PAH-sah
turns.native: Good morning. What's the matter?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Me duele la garganta y la cabeza desde hace dos días.
turns.phon: MEH DOOEH-leh LAH gahr-GAHN-tah EE LAH kah-BEH-sah DEHS-deh AH-seh DOHS DEE-ahs
turns.native: My throat and my head have been hurting for two days.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: ¿Tiene fiebre?
turns.phon: TEEEH-neh FEEEH-breh
turns.native: Do you have a fever?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: No mucho. Un poco por la noche.
turns.phon: NOH MOO-choh. OON POH-koh POHR LAH NOH-cheh
turns.native: Not much. A little at night.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Puede que sea un virus. Le voy a recetar algo.
turns.phon: POOEH-deh KEH SEH-ah OON VEE-roos. LEH VOHEE AH reh-seh-TAHR AHL-goh
turns.native: It might be a virus. I'm going to prescribe you something.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Si he entendido bien, no es grave, ¿no?
turns.phon: SEE EH ehn-tehn-DEE-doh BEEEHN, NOH EHS GRAH-veh, NOH
turns.native: If I've understood correctly, it's not serious, right?

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: No, pero es mejor descansar dos o tres días.
turns.phon: NOH, PEH-roh EHS meh-KHOHR dehs-kahn-SAHR DOHS OH TREHS DEE-ahs
turns.native: No, but it's best to rest for two or three days.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Hay un problema: mañana tengo que trabajar.
turns.phon: AHEE OON proh-BLEH-mah, mah-NYAH-nah TEHN-goh KEH trah-bah-KHAHR
turns.native: There's a problem: tomorrow I have to work.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Le hago un justificante. En parte depende de usted: descanse.
turns.phon: LEH AH-goh OON khoos-tee-fee-KAHN-teh. EHN PAHR-teh deh-PEHN-deh DEH oos-TEHD, dehs-KAHN-seh
turns.native: I'll write you a sick note. It partly depends on you: rest.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Gracias, doctor.
turns.phon: GRAH-seeahs, dohk-TOHR
turns.native: Thank you, doctor.

dialogues.practice: Listen to both roles, hide one role, answer, then swap one line for a variant of your own.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Buenos días, vengo a renovar mi tarjeta.
turns.phon: BOOEH-nohs DEE-ahs, VEHN-goh AH reh-noh-VAHR MEE tahr-KHEH-tah
turns.native: Good morning, I've come to renew my card.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: A ver… Falta un documento: el justificante de domicilio.
turns.phon: AH VEHR. FAHL-tah OON doh-koo-MEHN-toh, EHL khoos-tee-fee-KAHN-teh DEH doh-mee-SEE-leeoh
turns.native: Let's see… A document is missing: the proof of address.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Es decir, ¿una factura de la luz?
turns.phon: EHS deh-SEER, OO-nah fahk-TOO-rah DEH LAH LOOS
turns.native: In other words, an electricity bill?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Sí, o del agua.
turns.phon: SEE, OH DEHL AH-gooah
turns.native: Yes, or a water bill.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Puede que la tenga en el móvil. Un momento… Aquí está.
turns.phon: POOEH-deh KEH LAH TEHN-gah EHN EHL MOH-veel. OON moh-MEHN-toh. ah-KEE ehs-TAH
turns.native: I might have it on my phone. One moment… Here it is.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Perfecto. Pero no estoy seguro de la fecha: es de hace cuatro meses.
turns.phon: pehr-FEHK-toh. PEH-roh NOH ehs-TOHEE seh-GOO-roh DEH LAH FEH-chah, EHS DEH AH-seh KOOAH-troh MEH-sehs
turns.native: Perfect. But I'm not sure about the date: it's from four months ago.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: ¿Qué podemos hacer en este caso?
turns.phon: KEH poh-DEH-mohs ah-SEHR EHN EHS-teh KAH-soh
turns.native: What can we do in this case?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Más bien, tráigame una de este mes. Puede volver mañana sin cita.
turns.phon: MAHS BEEEHN, TRAHEE-gah-meh OO-nah DEH EHS-teh MEHS. POOEH-deh vohl-VEHR mah-NYAH-nah SEEN SEE-tah
turns.native: Actually, bring me one from this month. You can come back tomorrow without an appointment.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Si he entendido bien, vuelvo mañana con la factura, ¿no?
turns.phon: SEE EH ehn-tehn-DEE-doh BEEEHN, VOOEHL-voh mah-NYAH-nah KOHN LAH fahk-TOO-rah, NOH
turns.native: If I've understood correctly, I come back tomorrow with the bill, right?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Exacto. Hasta mañana.
turns.phon: ehk-SAHK-toh. AHS-tah mah-NYAH-nah
turns.native: Exactly. See you tomorrow.

dialogues.practice: Listen to both roles, hide one role, answer, then swap one line for a variant of your own.

readiness: Rephrase and clarify what you mean, give a nuanced answer, express uncertainty (quizás, puede que + subjunctive), report a problem (delay, mistake, lost item, missing document), look for a solution and check that you've understood.
